previous.changeLog: Added GIF and animated WebP support for custom camouflages and projection decals, with animated previews and playback in the hangar, Exterior, and battles. Also improved loading for long animations and fixed duplicate custom assets.

current.changeLog: Fixed animated custom camouflages and projection decals sometimes showing missing textures after switching World of Tanks clients or failing to restart after leaving Exterior. Large GIF and animated WebP imports now run in the background with visible progress instead of freezing the Local Assets page. Also improved animation resource synchronization, loading, and fallback behavior.
